findings.description: The policy attached to svc_deploy grants ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on Resource "*", giving this long-lived deployment user full control over compute, storage, and serverless services across the account, including the ability to read all S3 data and modify or delete any EC2/Lambda resource.

Because the policy Resource is "*", the user can call iam:PassRole-adjacent service actions and create or modify resources (e.g. Lambda functions or EC2 instances) with arbitrary high-privilege roles, and combine ec2:* with lambda:* to escalate to account administrator. There is no boundary restricting which roles can be passed.

An IAM access key pair is created for the service user, producing long-lived AWS credentials that never expire and must be manually rotated. Combined with the wildcard policy above, compromise of this key grants broad account access.
